comments.author: Mugnum
comments.body_html:
Angel, it definitely sounds like you have an imbalanced system. 30 FPS on 3090 is mental.

My current system is AMD 9950x3D, RTX 4070, RAM 6000 MHz at 30CL, playing at 1440p. Previously had 5800x3D and it’s been pretty rough, bumping up CPU made a world of difference, heard Tarkov loves that X3D cache.

  • Customs is the best case scenario: 180 FPS and limited by GPU (meaning yours should push even further).
  • Woods: 120 FPS and constantly limited by GPU. For funsies set DLSS to performance and it reached 150 FPS (at 1440p, no AI limit).
    For comparison, on 5800x3D I’ve averaged 70 FPS on Woods (at 1080p, with AI limit).
  • Interchange: 90 FPS indoors.
  • Streets: averages at 50 FPS, it’s bad. I enable Lossless Scaling frame gen on Streets, which definitely makes it a lot smoother.

Here are 120 FPS offline clips to get the feel of it: archive.

Are you on laptop by chance? Might be a severe overheating issue, where lack of airflow makes system throttle itself to prevent meltdown.
